name: Battle Live: Valentines and White Day Live
source:
Pride Park's most anticipated duo of events are drawing near; the annual Valentine's and White Day lives! 

The Valentine's Live is the first! 
With love in the air, the fans and school vote for the unit that'll be the leads of this heart-felt yearly event. This year Neapolitan was chosen, but it seems like a certain member has other things on his mind before the love fades away...

A month later is The White Day Live!
To show thanks for the support given during the Valentine's live a month prior, one unit is voted to be the leads of this event! But while the fans get to see the joyful live, the students also have one important thing to worry about after; graduation.

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/vday-and-white-day-live] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
普莱德公园 (Pride Park) 最受期待的两项活动即将来临；一年一度的情人节和白色情人节生活！

情人节现场是第一个！
空气中弥漫着爱的气息，球迷和学校投票选出将成为这一衷心年度活动的主角的单位。今年选择了那不勒斯，但在爱情消失之前，某个成员似乎还有其他的想法……

一个月后，白色情人节现场！
为了感谢一个月前情人节现场的支持，投票选出了一个单位作为本次活动的主角！不过，在粉丝们看到欢乐的现场表演的同时，学生们也有一件重要的事情需要担心：毕业。

[来自[url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/vday-and-white-day-live] itch.io[/url]]
